s00.text: ከቤቴ ርቄ ያሳለፍኩትን የመጀመሪያ ሌሊት መቼም አልረሳውም። ጊዜው መስከረም ሁለት ሺህ አሥራ ሁለት ነበር።
s00.subtitle: I will never forget the first night I spent far from home. It was Meskerem 2012 (late 2019).

subtitle_check.literal: I will never forget the first night I spent far from my home. The time was Meskerem 2012.

s01.text: አሥራ ሁለተኛ ክፍልን እንደጨረስኩ ባሕር ዳር ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተመደብኩ። እኩለ ቀን ላይ፣ አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ፣ ጓደኛዬ ሸኝቶኝ ከአንኮበር ተነሳሁ።
s01.subtitle: When I finished twelfth grade, I was assigned to Bahir Dar University. At midday, with just one backpack, seen off by my friend, I left Ankober.

subtitle_check.literal: As soon as I finished twelfth grade, I was assigned to Bahir Dar University. At midday, carrying only one backpack, with my friend seeing me off, I set out from Ankober.

s02.text: መንገዱ እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን ፒስታ፣ ከዚያ አስፋልት ነበር።
s02.subtitle: The road was gravel as far as Debre Birhan, then asphalt.

subtitle_check.literal: The road was gravel (dirt) as far as Debre Birhan, then it was asphalt.

s03.text: መስኮት ዳር ተቀምጬ ደኑንና ተራራውን በመደነቅ እመለከት ነበር።
s03.subtitle: Sitting by the window, I watched the forest and the mountain in wonder.

subtitle_check.literal: Sitting by the window, I was watching the forest and the mountain in wonder.

s04.text: ከመሸ በኋላ ላምበረት ስደርስ ሌላ ጓደኛዬ ይጠብቀኝ ነበር። አዲስ አበባ በሰው፣ በመብራትና በመኪና ተጥለቅልቃ ተቀበለችኝ፤ ወዴት እንደምመለከት ጠፋኝ።
s04.subtitle: When I reached Lamberet after dark, another friend was waiting for me. Addis Ababa met me flooded with people, lights and cars; I did not know where to look.

subtitle_check.literal: When I arrived at Lamberet after it got dark, another friend of mine was waiting for me. Addis Ababa received me flooded with people, lights and cars; I lost track of where to look.

s05.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደግሞ ደላሎች ከበቡን።
s05.subtitle: And when we reached Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us.

subtitle_check.literal: And when we reached Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us.

s06.text: «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ? አልጋ?» ማንን እንደምንሰማ ግራ ገባን። በመጨረሻ አንዱን ተከተልን።
s06.subtitle: "Do you want a bed? A bed?" We did not know whom to listen to. In the end we followed one.

subtitle_check.literal: "Do you want a bed? A bed?" We were confused about whom to listen to. Finally we followed one.

s07.text: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ነበር፤ ጥሩም መጥፎም አልነበረም፤ ግን ንጹሕ ነበር።
s07.subtitle: The room had one bed; it was neither good nor bad; but it was clean.

subtitle_check.literal: The room was a single-bed room; it was neither good nor bad; but it was clean.

s08.text: በማግስቱ ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን የባሕር ዳር ትኬት ቆረጥን።
s08.subtitle: Next morning we stood in a long queue and bought the ticket to Bahir Dar.

subtitle_check.literal: The next morning, having lined up in a long queue, we bought a ticket for Bahir Dar.

s09.text: ዛሬ፣ ከሰባት ዓመት በኋላ፣ ከቤቱ ለሚወጣ ሁሉ የምለው አንድ ነገር አለኝ፦ የመጀመሪያው ሌሊት ሁሌም ግራ ያጋባል። ግራ መጋባቱ ግን የጉዞው አካል ነው። አትሽሸው፤ አጣጥመው።
s09.subtitle: Today, seven years later, I have one thing to say to all who leave home: the first night is always confusing. But the confusion is part of the journey. Do not run from it; savour it.

subtitle_check.literal: Today, seven years later, I have one thing I say to everyone who leaves home: the first night is always confusing. But the confusion is part of the journey. Do not flee from it; savour it.
